name: native-profile-bootstrap
goal: Normal profiling configuration starts without native Node TypeScript support, while retaining root and inherited-workspace evidence and worker limits.

evidence: Adoption commitadbe75a1 dynamically imports a typed startup entry and passed on local Node25 with native type stripping. Disabling that capability reproduces ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION in the product bootstrap; installed Vite can compile its implementation without requiring native TS.

Expand existing normal workspace-configuration test across native startup capabilities, using the host-supported disabling flag when available. Each root/inherited execution must start and add fresh observations; assert product startup errors explicitly. This is a product loading defect, not a missing fixture.

Initial47273755 proof0bef7885 establishes native TS startup failure. Latest lint-compliant test/fixture commitdcc22749 re-sealed asa658c9f6 with both owning test and shared fixture named; ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION still proves the product boundary failure.

Keep a native JavaScript startup entry, ask the installed Vite loader to compile typed tooling, and remove the native typed hop. Preserve frozen root/workspace configs and each execution capture assertion.

All27 focused integration cases pass together, including native TS disabled. Types, lint, audit and registry pass; skill validates. Existing SDK API source is unchanged from its successful packed-consumer check.
Paired red225b052a atdcc22749 and green9dda3faf at391bfba6 execute identical test/fixture inputs and runner configs in one environment; all six cases pass including unavailable native TypeScript.

The isolated earlier native entry forwards to typed startup and fails ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION. Repaired JavaScript startup passes both root and inherited capability variants with fresh captures; existing worker and sparse-startup cases remain green.
